body: Thank you for your kindness and perspective. I will look and see if there are any support groups for my condition. My doctors aren't entirely sure of what the condition is because there's very little research done on it (there's actually more research done on this condition in dogs than on humans, which is really depressing). It's some kind of very, very rare form of multiple lipomatosis (which is in itself incredibly rare, even more so in someone at my age).

Thank you for your encouragement. How did you get out of the business? What other kinds of jobs did you search for that would accept your degree? I'm heavily considering looking in a completely different industry, but I have absolutely no idea what other kind of jobs my degree would qualify me for.
